notes: The BS requires EECS 330 Data Structures and Algorithms, so C3 is that course (the BS has no separate required algorithms course; EECS 510 is theory of computing). The required capstone EECS 582 was not needed because EECS 348 Software Engineering I is required. C1 and C2 syllabi come from the department wiki, which holds Fall 2026 syllabi.
